versions.content: {DRAFT} Upon invocation o f StbM_CanSetSlaveTimingData() CanTSyn shall pass following values  the sequence counter value from the transmitter (Time Master), Specification of Time Synchronization over CAN AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 39 of 79 Document ID 674 : AUTOSAR_SWS_TimeSyncOverCAN - AUTOSAR confidential -  T2 VLT as syncIngressTimestamp for the SYNC Message (refer to step 1 in [SWS_CanTSyn_00073] ),  T0 + T4 as preciseOriginTimestamp received from the Time Master (refer to [SWS_CanTSyn_00073] ) to the function by the parameter measureDataPtr . Struct members  measureDataPtr - >referenceLocalTimestamp and  measureDataPtr - >r efrenceGlobalTimestamp shall be passed as 0.

Upon invocation o f StbM_ CanSetSlaveTimingData() CanTSyn shall pass following values  the sequence counter value from the transmitter (Time Master),  the segment id of the physical channel on which the Sync message has been received (refer to parameter CanTSynGlobalTim eNetworkSegme ntId ( ECUC_CanTSyn_00052 : ) )  T2 VLT as syncIngressTimestamp for the SYNC Message (refer to step 1 in [SWS_CanTSyn_00073] ),  T0 + T4 as preciseOriginTimestamp received from the Time Master (refe r to [SWS_CanTSyn_00073] ) to the function by the parameter measureDataPtr . Struct members  measureDataPtr - >referenceLocalTimestamp and  measureDataPtr - >r efrenceGlobalTimestamp shall be passed as 0.

Upon invocation of StbM_CanSetSlaveTimingData CanTSyn shall pass following values • the sequence counter value from the transmitter (Time Master), • the segment id of the physical channel on which the SYNC message has been received (refer to parameter CanTSynGlobalTimeNetworkSegmentId ) • T2 VLT as syncIngressTimestamp for the SYNC message (refer to step 1 in [SWS_CanTSyn_00144], [SWS_CanTSyn_00147] and [SWS_CanTSyn_00148]), • T0 + T4 as preciseOriginTimestamp received from the Time Master (refer to [SWS_CanTSyn_00144] and [SWS_CanTSyn_00145]) to the function by the parameter measureDataPtr . Struct members • measureDataPtr → referenceLocalTimestamp and • measureDataPtr → referenceGlobalTimestamp shall be passed as 0.
